usage: workflow status [-h] [--path PATH] [--json]

Show the repo-owned v2 status view, including the health overview plus the
detailed manifest, mirror-lock/shim, memory, continuity-state, roots, role-
contract, and command/help/docs consistency sections.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --path PATH  Target repo path; defaults to the current directory
  --json       Emit machine-readable JSON instead of text
